title: Vercel public hosting of the Governance Studio (frontend + backend)

departs_from.note: P3E is ratified as single-tenant, private-hosted demonstration hosting. Serving it from Vercel is a public-Internet deployment and therefore a departure from that ratified boundary, recorded here rather than made silently.

what_is_deployed: the frontend and the backend together, as one ASGI application, on Vercel

tls_termination.rationale: Vercel terminates TLS at the edge, so the process holds no certificate and the ratified certificate-file check cannot apply.
tls_termination.implementation: DeploymentConfig gains an explicit tls_termination mode. In 'platform' mode the certificate-file checks are replaced by ForwardedProtoGuardMiddleware, which refuses any request whose forwarded client leg is not https.
tls_termination.not_a_relaxation: HTTPS remains mandatory. Enforcement is relocated from a certificate to a per-request check, and fails closed: a missing forwarded-protocol header is refused rather than assumed secure.
tls_termination.guardrail: 'platform' mode is rejected in configuration unless the proxy is trusted, because reading that header from an untrusted peer would let a client assert its own transport security.

spa_behind_auth.decision: route every request through the Python function
spa_behind_auth.rationale: the access gate is ASGI middleware; anything the CDN serves directly would bypass it
spa_behind_auth.consequence: the SPA, its assets and the API are all behind the same Basic-auth gate, as in the container. Cold starts are slower and there is no CDN caching; accepted for a demonstration deployment.

brute_force_cooldown.finding: FailureTracker holds failure counts in memory. Serverless instances do not share memory, so an attacker landing on a fresh instance meets a zeroed counter.
brute_force_cooldown.consequence: the bounded-cooldown property of gate P3E-CTR-08 DOES NOT HOLD in this deployment. It is materially weaker than the container deployment.

compensating_control.scope: per source IP, across the whole Python-routed application (every path, since all requests are rewritten to the function)
compensating_control.validation_required_before_the_pr_is_rea: confirm one authenticated page load followed by a full scenario walkthrough stays comfortably below 60 requests per minute, so the limit never fires during ordinary demonstration use
compensating_control.credential_requirement: a cryptographically generated password of at least 32 random bytes
compensating_control.evidence_class_note: The WAF rule is platform configuration, not behaviour of this application, and it is recorded as such. It is NOT application behaviour and does NOT satisfy gate P3E-CTR-08, whose bounded per-source cooldown is an application property this deployment does not provide.

rejected_alternatives.reason: out of scope for this change; it would supersede the deployment access gate entirely and is a larger change than this branch

brute_force_cooldown.owner_advice_recorded: credential strength is the effective defence here; provision a high-entropy password
brute_force_cooldown.nonconformance_status: REMAINS OPEN. The WAF rule mitigates the exposure; it does not restore the property. The ineffective cross-instance cooldown stays an explicit P3E nonconformance for as long as this deployment exists.

preserved_from_p3e: authenticated access to every path, including the SPA
no default credentials; Argon2id password hashing
strict security headers including HSTS and a CSP with no unsafe-* or wildcards
synthetic-data boundary: the pinned, hashed fixture manifest is verified at cold start and the application refuses to build on drift
no permission granting, no runtime provisioning, no agent execution, no business-action authorization

p3e_ctr_gate_family.reason: all thirteen P3E-CTR gates verify a built OCI image - non-root uid, single exposed port, read-only root filesystem, image layer secret scan, image vulnerability scan, clean-checkout rebuild. Vercel does not run that image.
p3e_ctr_gate_family.consequence: this deployment carries NO container gate evidence. It is not gated by the P3E-CTR family, and no P3E-CTR gate may be described as passed, satisfied or waived on account of it. Every P3E-CTR gate remains NOT_EXECUTED.
p3e_ctr_gate_family.not_a_retirement: the P3E-CTR family and the container deployment it describes are unchanged by this record

weakened_or_inapplicable.startup_integrity_report: the container's fail-closed startup integrity sequence and its written report are not reproduced; the entrypoint performs the configuration and synthetic-bundle checks only

not_claimed: container gate evidence of any kind
suitability for real, customer or enterprise data
that the WAF rate limit satisfies or substitutes for gate P3E-CTR-08

verification_performed.ratified_code_regression: the full deployment suite passes unchanged after the config and middleware change
verification_performed.new_tests: deployment/governance-studio/tests/test_platform_tls.py - twelve tests covering that the container mode still requires certificates, that platform mode is refused without a trusted proxy, that a missing or plaintext forwarded protocol is refused before the auth gate reads any credential, and that authentication still applies over https
verification_performed.end_to_end: the Vercel entrypoint was built and exercised locally: unauthenticated SPA and API requests return 401, authenticated requests return 200 and serve all four scenarios, a request without a forwarded-protocol header returns 400, and HSTS, CSP and nosniff headers are present
verification_performed.not_verified: no deployment to Vercel was performed or observed from this environment. The Vercel project configuration - build, function packaging, routing and dependency installation - is unverified against the platform.

residual_risks: the repository-root requirements.txt carries research and training dependencies; the function must install api/requirements.txt instead, and a build that picks up the root file will fail or bloat
cold start executes the synthetic-bundle verification on every new instance, adding latency
the deployment is publicly reachable, so the credential is the only barrier and the cooldown does not hold
